description: The bar chart illustrates the runtime comparison of different models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis lists the model names, namely "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude", in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "Runtime (seconds)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 seconds, with tick labels at intervals of 50 seconds. Each model is represented by a single bar, with "Our Joint Framework" colored green and the other models, categorized as "LLM Models", colored blue. The bars represent the runtime of each model, with values of 77 seconds for "Our Joint Framework", 190 seconds for "ChatGPT", 365 seconds for "DeepSeek", 172 seconds for "LLaMA", and 243 seconds for "Claude". The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and "Our Joint Framework" is visually distinguished from the other models by its green color.
